optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Staff Engineer, Build and CI Platform
professionalSummary: Senior engineer with four years of experience on a CI runners team within a build platform group, delivering autoscaling and cache service changes with documented rollout and rollback plans. Demonstrated leadership in design reviews, architecture decision record contributions, and participation in the architecture council. Prior mobile app engineering experience adds cross‑domain perspective.
experienceHighlights: Led runner autoscaling and cache service enhancements, each accompanied by detailed rollout and rollback documentation.
Acted as one of two design reviewers for the CI runners team, providing structured feedback recorded on design documents.
Contributed the runners section to architecture decision records authored by the group’s staff engineer and attended architecture council sessions as a guest.
Authored boundary notes for design reviews and decision record sections, ensuring clear documentation of scope.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Runner autoscaling change tickets with rollout and rollback plans; design review comments for a sample change; runners section of an architecture decision record—available as a work sample with verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample confirm the candidate’s technical contributions, design review participation, and documentation practices, but do not establish that she authored architecture decision records or represented the platform in the architecture council.
